title: Conflux
summary: CONFLUX, noun [Latin See Confluence.] 1. A flowing together; a meeting of two or more currents of a fluid. 2. A collection; a crowd; a multitude collected; as a general conflux of people.

inlines.v: CONFLUX, noun [Latin See Confluence.] 1. A flowing together; a meeting of two or more currents of a fluid. 2. A collection; a crowd; a multitude collected; as a general conflux of people.
